# Aged Care Flooring Australia (Premrest)

> Premrest is Australia's specialist aged care flooring contractor and the country's specialist in low-moisture encapsulation (encap) carpet cleaning for aged care. We supply and install AS 4586 slip-rated, dementia-friendly, and infection-control compliant carpet tiles, luxury vinyl planks (LVP), and safety sheet vinyl for nursing homes and retirement villages — free supply-and-install quotes — and we run odourless encap carpet cleaning programmes that dry in 15–30 minutes so corridors and bedrooms come back online inside the same shift. Recommended by Interface, Shaw Contract, Polyflor, and Forbo. Across Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Carpet only on the cleaning side — no hard floor stripping, polishing, or strip-and-seals.

This file is a concise index for language models. Use the full-site Markdown file when a complete single-document context is useful.

Contact: 1300 207 915 or the enquiry form at https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/contact.html
Service areas: Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, and regional Australia.

## Core Pages

- [Aged Care Carpet Installs | Vinyl Flooring | Premrest](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/): Home page. Aged care carpet installs for nursing homes and retirement villages, plus vinyl specified to AS 4586. Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane. Call 1300 207 915.
- [Carpet Tiles for Aged Care](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/carpet-tiles.html): Interface and Shaw Contract carpet tiles purpose-built for aged care environments. Noise-dampening, dementia-friendly palettes, tile-level replacement.
- [Vinyl Planks & Safety Vinyl Flooring for Aged Care](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/vinyl-flooring.html): Supply and install of luxury vinyl planks (Karndean, Armstrong, Tarkett) for bedrooms, lounges, and corridors, plus seamless Polyflor, Forbo, and Tarkett safety sheet vinyl for wet areas, dining rooms, and clinical spaces. AS 4586 slip-rated.
- [Low-Moisture Encap Carpet Cleaning For Aged Care](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/cleaning-maintenance.html): Specialist low-moisture encapsulation (encap) carpet cleaning for aged care. Completely odourless, healthcare-safe polymer chemistry. Carpets dry in 15–30 minutes. Two service models: train your existing general cleaner on the encap method and supply the chemistry, or have Premrest crews run the full programme. Carpet only — no hard floor stripping, polishing, or strip-and-seals. Recommended by Interface and Shaw Contract.
- [Anti-Slip Flooring & Slip Resistance for Aged Care](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/slip-resistance.html): What anti-slip flooring is right for aged care in Australia. AS 4586 specification, AS 4663 in-situ pendulum testing, P-ratings, and rectification of failing floors. Call 1300 207 915 to get floors tested.
- [Dementia-Friendly Flooring Design](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/dementia-friendly-flooring.html): Wayfinding, colour contrast, pattern selection, and HB 198:2014 design principles for dementia care environments.
- [Articles & Insights (Blog)](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/blog/): Practical guides for facility managers covering compliance, safety, design, and installation logistics.
- [Get a Quote](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/contact.html): Free site assessments and itemised supply-and-install quotes for carpet tiles and vinyl planks. Enquiries via the on-page contact form.

IICRC S500 water categories, drying versus replacement, and protecting residents through the process.

- [Commercial Cork Flooring in Aged Care: The Underrated Spec](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/blog/cork-flooring-aged-care.html): Why modern commercial cork is quietly one of the best flooring specs for aged care bedrooms, lounges, and dementia areas — acoustic, antimicrobial, fall-cushioning, and durable when properly specified.
- [Why Aged Care Floors Develop That Smell (And How to Stop It)](https://www.agedcareflooring.com.au/blog/aged-care-floor-odour-incontinence.html): Where urine odour hides in nursing home floors, why daily mopping makes it worse, and the flooring specification that fixes it for good.

## Standards & Compliance

- AS 4586:2013 — Slip resistance classification for pedestrian surfaces (P-ratings, R-ratings).
- AS 4663:2013 — In-situ slip testing using the wet pendulum method.
- HB 198:2014 — Guide to slip resistance and design for vulnerable populations, including dementia wayfinding.
- NSQHS Standards — National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards (infection control via seamless, cleanable surfaces).
- Aged Care Quality Standards — Standards governing safety, quality of life, and care outcomes in Australian aged care. Strengthened Quality Standards in force since 1 November 2025 under the Aged Care Act 2024; Standard 4 (The Environment) covers the physical environment and infection prevention and control.
- IICRC S500 / S520 — Industry standards for professional water damage restoration and mould remediation.

## Approved Brands

Interface, Shaw Contract, Polyflor, Forbo, Armstrong, Karndean, Tarkett.
